To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the translation of maize polysomes is inhibited by the replacement of K+ by sodium in a more sensitive manner than the translation of sugar beet polysomos.
the translation of mRNA is inhibited by the replacement of potassium ions by sodium ions.
the in vitro translation by polysomes isolated from sugar beet and maize was significantly inhibited by a substitution of K+ with Na+ in the nutrition solution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the elucidation of the mechanism of salt tolerance of sugar beet.
the identification of salt tolerance mechanisms in plants.
the elucidation of the molecular basis for the salt tolerance of sugar beet.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the salt resistance is not only based on an increased Na+ tolerance of the sugar beet but also on a lower sensitivity of the translation process to the substitution of the cations in the nutrition.
in vitro translation is inhibited by the Na+ substitution in a concentration dependent manner and that this effect is different for sugar beet and maize.
the substitution of K by Na in the nutrition of sugar beet is tolerated by the plant and that the substitution does not lead to a significant reduction of net protein synthesis in sugar beet.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the in vitro translation of both plant species is inhibited by the Na+ substitution of K+ in the nutrient solution.
the substitution of potassium by sodium is not tolerated well by the plant.

sugar beet is more salt resistant than maize and that the salt resistance of plants is based on the ability to tolerate increased Na+ concentrations in the cytosol and to keep the Na+/K+ ratio within certain limits.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the in vitro approach is a valuable and useful tool to investigate mechanisms of plant responses to Na+ stress.
the translation by sugar beet ribosomes is less inhibited by Na+ than that by maize ribosomes.
the substitution of K by Na+ in the nutrition is restricted because it inhibits the activity of ribosome.
